Browns QB Deshaun Watson has cleared the NFL's concussion protocol but is expected to be inactive today, source said. Watson only practiced once, and Shedeur Sanders will start.

Bucs WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) is playing today after being listed as questionable. He missed Wednesday but was a full participant after that.
